articleTitle: Review on Intrusion Detection in Edge Based IOT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: A smart environment is essential in today's society. The term “smart environment” is used to describe an environment that is advanced in several ways. These may include technological advancements, improved infrastructure, improved modes of transportation, improved health care delivery, and other developments. With the help of the Internet of Things, smart environments may achieve their main objective of improving the quality of people's daily lives (IoT). In this context, “things” means any Internet-enabled device. IoT's total reliance on the Internet raises serious issues about security and privacy. Traditional methods of addressing security and privacy threats cannot be used with IoT devices because of their limited storage, processing capability, and dependence on external power sources. That's why it's crucial to develop a sophisticated IDS that can perform reliably in an IoT environment. Intruder detection systems (IDS) might be signature-based, anomaly-based, or hybrid. The delay introduced by IoT devices is particularly problematic for use in time-sensitive scenarios. To solve for this delay issue, edge computing was created. Machine learning is one approach that may be used to implement IDS. The purpose of this research is to learn everything that can be learned about various machine learning-based models for vulnerability scanning in edge-based Internet of Things (IoT) networks.

articleTitle: High Level Learning Approach for High Level Collision Avoidance Using Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Motion planning for many unmanned aircraft is challenging because they have a larger configuration space than self-driving automobile development (Automated guided vehicles). Additionally, there are more significant uncertainties and disruptions in UAV environments, which makes inter automatic navigation more difficult. In this letter, I proposed a 2 recurrent neural networks (RL) oriented multi-UAV collision avoidance technique by modeling the unpredictability or noise in the environment. Our objective is to create a strategy that can construct a path without clashing with anything using local noisy data. But unlike supervised algorithms, RL lacks a steady training data set with floor labels, thus its collision avoidance strategies often show significant fluctuation and are difficult to reproduce. To solve these issues, we created a two-stage training method for RL-based collision avoidance. We first optimize the policy, and then we utilize a supervised learning methodology with a loss function that encourages the agents to adopt the well-known reciprocity obstacle detection mechanism. In the second step, we use transmission to fine-tune the policy. The complete computer simulation findings demonstrate that this approach can handle noisy local views with erratic sound levels and can design moment & accident paths under inadequate sensing. We review the impact of our policies in a variety of ways.

abstract: The new coronavirus, initially detected in Wuhan, China, has spread worldwide, wreaking devastation. articleTitle: Brand Usability- As one of the elements of Halo Effect in case of online banking industry
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: The user experience (UE) is one of the important component in banking services (Marous, 2017) (Jeon, 2016). This study focuses on identifying whether the brand equity of certain reputed private banks extends to their online applications user experience by determining the influence of brand's usability equity (Ebbing, 2017) and desirability (Ebbing, 2017) on the expected and perceived user experience of online banking. A regression model for every factor is developed using various factors such as usability equity, brand desirability, perceived user experience and expected user experience (Birkett, 2021), where sample size of 100 users of online banking services are considered. The results showed that usability equity shows a significant positive correlation with brand usability and perceived usability (Ebbing, 2017) (Vassileva, 2021). This study is the cross-sectional study wherein data is collected from users of online banking services provided by private banks through google-forms between the time frame of August 2021- December 2021. So there is scope of respondent's bias. Since very limited work has been performed in this area of halo effect in banking sector so it will help in developing a better understanding of the concept of HALO-effect in marketing of various types of products. articleTitle: Parametric evaluation of V2V communication in Vehicular Ad hoc Networks

abstract: In order to implement a Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET) in the absence of a predetermined network architecture, moving vehicles can use wireless technology to connect to each other in order to form a Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET). Simulating VANETs typically involves two distinct stages that need to be taken into consideration. The simulation of traffic flows takes place first, followed by a simulation of the underlying network in order to understand how it works. In order to improve the realism of a VANET simulation, it is necessary to simulate the propagation of waves between the vehicles within the VANET. Vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication has been hampered by a number of impediments, such as the precise location and mobility of vehicles, due to the focus of research on the impact of vehicles on vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication. A proposed model considers automobiles as obstacles, with their effect on LOS blockage, received signal power, and packet reception rate being accounted for, depending on the effects they have on line-of-sight (LOS) obstructions. When a vehicle blocks the line of sight (LOS), there is a significant attenuation in the signal and packet loss, and it has been demonstrated that these blockers significantly decrease the power of the signal received by the antenna.

articleTitle: The efficient data prediction and clustered compressive sensing (CCS) in environmental application of WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are built from nodes called mod - small autonomous devices powered by batteries and microchips with radio communication at a frequency - for example 2.4 GHz. A special software allows mods to be organized into distributed networks, communicate with each other, interrogate and exchange data with adjacent nodes, the distance of which is usually no more than 100 meters. A wireless sensor network (WSN) is a wireless network consisting of geographically distributed autonomous devices that use sensors to collectively monitor physical or environmental conditions in different areas. They can measure parameters such as temperature, sound, vibration, and pressure, movement of objects or wind. The development of wireless sensor networks was initially motivated by military tasks such as battlefield surveillance. In this paper discussed in detail about, wireless sensor networks are increasingly used in many areas of civil life, including industrial and environmental monitoring, healthcare, and material movement control. The main operational processing of the data collected by the motes is carried out at the node or gateway, which is a very powerful computer. But to process the data, you have to get it first. For this purpose, the node must be equipped with an antenna. But in any case, only objects close to it are accessible to the node; In other words, node does not receive information directly from each node

articleTitle: Design of Smart Attachment for Refrigerator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: In recent years the emergence of e-commerce platforms like Bigbasket, Blinkit, Amazon Fresh, Swiggy Instamart, and many more offering quick door deliveries online shopping has become an emerging trend. With the recent pandemic, online shopping for groceries is increased by 45% while shopping at grocery stores is reduced by around 30%. The problem with online shopping is that comparing the prices of groceries among online vendors is difficult. To solve this issue this paper presents an add-on attachment to an existing refrigerator to convert it into a smart refrigerator. The system uses image-based grocery detection using SSD Mobnet Convolutional Neural Network model which identifies the grocery and returns the price of detected grocery from various e-commerce platform, from which the user can choose to purchase grocery for a favourable vendor. API created using selenium acts as a gateway between the system and the e-commerce platform to fetch real time information. The main motivation is to create a user-friendly attachment which aids users to be more economical.

articleTitle: Enhanced Wireless based mobile charging application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: This article outlines the foundation and basic principles of a wireless charging system for mobile devices and constructs one utilising GPMQ8005B and BQ51013B. At the transmitter and receiver, coupling coils are constructed. In the design and development, the significance of the coils and receiving coil in the system is made clear. Finally, it is concluded that the system's transmission efficiency increases with coil diameter, decreasing with coil diameter, shorter distances increase transmission efficiency, longer distances decrease transmission efficiency, and coil diameter increases with coil diameter and number of turns, which provides a certain data reference for further research.’

articleTitle: The intelligent load optimization based safety system in electrical television network based on the starting loads
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: One of the most interesting aspects of televisions is this type - pulse source electricity, very light and compact, when in good condition, gives good output characteristics. This article describes how to build a power source based on the MP-3-3. If you are engaged in repairing the USCD, you should know that if the MP-3-3 is plugged into the network without load, it will not work. A safety system is activated, which monitors not only overload, but also “under load”. Therefore, in order to use the MP-3-3 as a laboratory, that is, with various loads, it must be loaded. The proposed to load each MP-3-3 output sources with starting loads, but, as practice shows; There is no need to do so. The fact is that the protection system does not monitor the currents in all the secondary windings of the pulse transformer. It is important for her to get the volume in the second round. Then, for any second round, it doesn't matter. In addition, to bring the source into stabilization mode, it must be loaded with at least 20W, and with the resistance of the resistors indicated in L.1, in total, no more than 3–4 W is obtained. Bring the source to operating mode, this is not enough.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Power Quality Issues in Grid-Integrated Wind Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Nowadays, with non-renewable energy sources dwindling, consumer demand for power is rising dramatically. So we turned to renewable sources like wind and solar in order to reduce the disparity between supply and demand. We use renewable resources in conjunction with conventional systems since they cannot meet demand on their own. We must therefore integrate renewable energy sources into the grid. The system encounters several power quality problems while performing this. However, this integration presents numerous operational and control difficulties that limit the grids' ability to run steadily and dependably. This paper discusses a thorough analysis of each of these problems and their solutions. It also covered the fundamentals of grid integration and offered advice on how to prepare effectively.

articleTitle: IoT Based Health Machine for COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: The new Corona Virus (COVID-19) is a pandemic of unthinkable scope and magnitude that is posing a significant threat to the medical business worldwide in the twenty-first century. To a greater extent, it has fundamentally altered the texture of life. The growing number of people dying as a result of sickness has instilled fear in the minds of many who are hesitant to seek even basic medical help. And, in light of the recent COVID-19 scenario and the growing number of affected people, researchers began to focus on ways to communicate and monitor patient information remotely in order to reduce the risk of getting infected. The Internet of Things (IoT) is one of the booming technologies in the medical and industrial fields. Patients could benefit from the proposed device because it can monitor and diagnose their health status. This study describes a gadget that measures and records heart rate, body temperature, and CT imaging. These records will be measured and sent to the cloud server using an Arduino device with sensors.

articleTitle: The intelligent information protection model from the harmful internet activities in bigdata storage systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: In general, information can be protected from various harmful Internet activities and various problems associated with computer malfunctions. Although not the most convenient program for creating a copy of a disk, it is quite complete in its capabilities. It allows you to copy and restore both individual partitions and the entire disk, and the disk image can be read and written over the network via a parallel or USB port, and stored on CD-R / RW or other removable media. In this paper, the intelligent information protection model was proposed to enhance the security from the harmful internet activities in big data storage systems. This program implements all the main functions that one can only expect from such a solution: from one hard disk to another hard disk or to a file (disk image), copying disk partitions HDD, removable media and password protected and compressed files. The package contains a lot. It allows you to view a disk image and recover individual files. The program provides functions to check the disk surface for errors and bad sectors and has the ability to copy “from sector to sector” if the user wants to get an exact copy of the disk. A very simple and intuitive interface makes it easy to back up your hard drive and the process of restoring it later. In the Ghost Explorer window, you can drag and drop files and folders into or out of an image file. Launched from the command line, it has a unique set of features that experienced users know how to handle.

articleTitle: The smart magnetic cards based security measures for emergency situations in Industrial Management
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Security is not only protection from intruders but also providing preventive measures in emergency situations like explosion, fire etc. The list of measures the security system is called upon to undertake includes restricting access to certain premises. To do this, use a combination lock or a special card. In this paper, a smart magnetic cards based security model was proposed to measures for emergency situations in Industrial Management. There are magnetic cards, but their security is not very reliable. There are also Wi-Fi cards with magnetized wires and proximity cards with a chip. The most reliable is the electronic card. A reader reads the information from it, the data is recorded by the computer, and the controller gives permission to enter. Video surveillance is widely used in security. The operator can simultaneously view any number of rooms or spaces that are substantially removed from each other. Such systems consist of cameras and monitors that are very easy to control. They allow a person to control multiple objects, which is very convenient.

articleTitle: New Born Face Feature Extraction Recognition using Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Biometric techniques such as fingerprints, palm prints, irises, faces, and retinas are used to identify the individuals responsible for the forgery. The importance of facial recognition has grown as a direct result of the rise in the number of fakes. The information that makes up the repository for newborn babies comes from a wide variety of sources, and it features babies in a variety of poses and lighting conditions throughout many distinct galleries. A number of different facial recognition strategies and classification algorithms currently used in commercial systems are also examined as part of a standard benchmark test. The data set is obtained from the face of a newborn baby, then trained and tested with classification algorithms, and then compared based on a variety of performance indicators. The extractable features from a picture serve as the basis for the classification process, and some of these extracted features are also used for the purposes of training and testing in conjunction with the classification process. Different feature extraction strategies are investigated in this study, including local binary patterns (LBP), principal component analysis (PCA), and gray level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM). LBPs are described by their local binary patterns. Eigenfaces and Eigenvectors are produced using Principal Component Analysis, and second-order statistical features are constructed with Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix. Photographs of newborn babies displaying a variety of facial expressions use these techniques. The extracted features are provided as input to the support vector machine for classification. In comparison to the other feature extraction methods, the principal component analysis method had an accuracy of 91%, a better recognition rate, and a shorter computation time. Experiments have also shown that this method is superior to other.

articleTitle: An intelligent receiver model for locating electrical wiring gaps for cable continuity in tele-communication networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: It is often necessary to find out what goes through a set of wires, often to find out the integrity of the circuit, to check for a short circuit or an open. The transition of p-n unity diodes, transistors and other semiconductors, a device like a continuum can help us with this. It will undoubtedly be useful for both electricians and electronics. The fact is that using the dialing mode on a multi meter is not always convenient, and some do not have this function, so such a simple dialing will solve this problem. In this paper, an intelligent receiver model was proposed for locating electrical wiring gaps for cable continuity in tele-communication networks. Continuity is very practical; the tone of its sound depends on the resistance of the tested section of the circuit. High resistance, less clicks, respectively, with low resistance, there will be a lot of clicks, and they will be heard as a loud noise, the tone of which can be adjusted by sections: that is, a board already finished with a solder component, you can easily find a short circuit, and let's ask that p-n junctions short circuit, The tonality will be different. With a bit of practice, you can easily tell by sound where the emitter and collector are in a transistor.

articleTitle: Design & study of quadrature hybrid 4 port network for matching, isolation, and coupling around the operating frequency
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Quadrature hybrid 4 Port network (Branch Line couplers (BLC's)) is an electronic device which used for dividing the power in the various RF network. Due to high frequency application in the recent days it is to be quantified to build an extension version and quality in fabrication which provides high-performance component. In this paper, we are providing an outline of Microwave power dividers and couplers, with parameters like matching, isolation and coupling around the given operating frequency.

articleTitle: The performance optimization of CRC network scanners based on the calculation of CRC checksums
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Universal scanners are designed to search for and neutralize all types of viruses, regardless of the operating system the scanner is designed to work on. Specialized scanners are designed to neutralize only a limited number of viruses or a class such as macro viruses. Scanners are divided into resident (monitors), which scan on the fly, and non-resident, which only check the system on demand. In this paper The performance optimization of CRC network scanners based on the calculation of CRC checksums. As a rule, resident scanners provide more reliable computer protection because they react immediately to the appearance of a virus, while a non-resident scanner can identify a virus only during its next release. Network Vaccines are divided into two categories: infection-inducing network vaccines and infection-preventing network vaccines.

articleTitle: CNN-RNN Hybrid model based Hindi Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning models have tended to favor modern architectures based on the availability of huge data sets and increasing success rates. Due to the inherent complexities of the scripts and the freestyle nature of handwriting, it is extremely difficult to develop reliable lexicon-free handwritten text recognizers for Hindi. In the work that has been proposed, a CNN-RNN hybrid architecture has been used. This architecture draws its inspiration from recent developments in the use of residual blocks for training convolutional layers. A spatial transformer layer has also been included to learn a model that is invariant to handwriting distortions. The Indic Word Database is used for training and testing the model, and the results are analyzed based on word error rates and character error rates. For the purpose of script recognition, the Hindi script is taken into consideration. In the systems that have been proposed, using the synthetic data, an absolute extra reduction in WER is found.

articleTitle: Analysis of Different Algorithms to Predict Chronic Kidney Disease
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD), also referred to as chronic kidney failure, is a medical condition defined by a gradual loss of kidney function over a period of time. It is characterized by conditions that inhibit or worsen the ability of the kidneys to filter wastes from human blood. If the disease worsens, wastes could build up to alarming levels in our blood and lead to organ failure, after which dialysis or kidney transplant would be needed to maintain life. It could further cause complications such as high blood pressure, low blood count (also known as anaemia), reduced bone strength, poor health and nutrition, and neurological damage. Since these symptoms usually slowly develop over time, early diagnosis can help chronic kidney disease from getting worse. This paper aims to use a set of medical attributes and analyse different machine learning algorithms to develop a model that would help predict whether or not a patient has chronic kidney disease. It also aims to perform a comparative analysis of multiple classification algorithms along with ensemble stacking method by testing their performance.

articleTitle: Space reservation technique at distributed level for hiding reversible data in the encrypted images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Reversible information hiding (RDH) in protected images is now receiving greater attention from the study team. Since it safeguards the privacy of supplemental information while still being a covered media, it is attractive for application in analytics, online clouds, diagnostic devices, and other disciplines. This study proposes an original method for irreversible data hiding in secret picture (RDH-EI). After securing your cover image, our method uses the tactic of assigning adequate space for the additional data. We begin by identifying suitable blocks for data occlusion in various parts of the image. Before the photo is encoded, some of the S-box of these chunks are supported into other areas of the image to employ a high-performance traditional RDH approach. Once the image has been encrypted, these LSB-planes are used to hide further data. Restoration of the original cover image and error-free supplementary information extraction are often guaranteed. The proposed strategy is quite straightforward and simple to comprehend. Experiments' results show that our method is superior to traditional ones for embedding concealment in protected images.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Continuous Industrial Monitoring System with the Integration of Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Industries such as petroleum, oil, and gas face a high risk of fire outbreaks, which could result in massive destruction, loss of property, and most importantly loss of lives. It is critical to have a system in place that can keep the premises secure while also informing the appropriate people within the time frame specified if such an incident occurs. This paper describes an IoT-based continuous industrial monitoring system that is intended to detect fire (via smoke and temperature sensors) and gas leakage (using various gas sensors). Relays are used to automate the system. The Blynk IoT platform underpins the entire system. In addition, the Blynk platform provides cloud connectivity to the system, and sensor data is sent to the cloud. Furthermore, the user can monitor the substantial physical quantities via the AR/prototype glass with OLED, Blynk app and web-server, and LCD. The concerned individual is alerted about the values being exceeded during critical periods using a buzzer and a GSM module. Furthermore, a motor pump is connected to the relay to squirt out water when the fire/flame is detected.

articleTitle: A reliable security model that protects ultra-dense enterprise cloud networks from highly vulnerable cyber attacks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Ransom ware is dangerous software that can steal data from a computer. Also worth making files unusable. After the attack through this, the hackers will ask for money to release these hacked files on the Enterprise's financial assets or the assets of its customers. Insider attacks by individuals trusted by organizations have become more prominent in recent years, leading years. That's a big question in today's cyber security world. However, it is an unnecessary question for two reasons. Because the time to help many victims of cyber-attacks has probably passed.. In this paper a smart security algorithm was proposed to prevent the ultra-dense organizational cloud network users from the cyber attacks. However, it also relates to good practices for protecting information and preventing or detecting cyber-attacks to which any organization or person is exposed. In a comparison tip, the proposed model achieved 92.26% of VPN data transfer rate, 93% of information protection, 96.74<sup>%</sup> of file back-up protection, 94.94<sup>%</sup> of HTTPS and SSL protection and 95.85% of codeword protection. Companies in dire straits have already paid hackers. Other companies have found a way to recover their files without hackers. The second reason is that the unnamed credible person may be in direct contact with the perpetrators..

articleTitle: The Role of Arduino Uno in Voice Recognition Process with Atmega328P
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: The use of robots in business and domestic settings has become more important as a means of transforming difficult tasks into ones that can be completed in a manner that is both more efficient and less taxing. A significant amount of study is being done on the subject of improving the link between people and robots. The purpose of this study is to provide the findings of the fieldwork into the requirement gathering of a speech conversational automaton utilising a smartphone that is dependent on Arduino Uno. The speech is being used as the controlling mechanism for the automaton locomotion, as well as the robot should respond to the individuals who are giving it commands by simulating the voices of a person speaking in answer to each vocal order. The suggested system will be constructed using a microchip as its foundation. This device will be linked to an intelligent smartphone utilizing Bluetooth module in order to receive voice recognition. An application on the Android phone interprets the spoken command, then converts it into text and transmits it to the microcontroller so that it may be used to manage the speed of the motors. Following the receipt of the information, the robot will respond appropriately to the order by carrying out the appropriate motion in the adequate position in accordance with the spoken instructions.

articleTitle: Next generation smart routing optimization of network storage devices using hybrid data management model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Currently, solid state drives are used in small devices: laptops, net books, communicators and smart phones, but can be used in standard computers to improve performance. Some well-known manufacturers have already switched to the production of solid state drives, for example, Samsung sold the manufacturing business of hard drives to Seagate. Due to the current proportionally high cost of solid state drives, so-called hybrid hard drives have emerged, among others. Such devices combine a hard disk (HDD) and solid state drive relatively small size, as a temporary storage (to increase the performance and service life of the device, to reduce power consumption). These drives are built around the use of volatile memory (like that used in a personal computer's RAM), characterized by high -speed reading, writing, and searching for information. Their main disadvantage is the high cost. They are mainly used to speed up the work of large database management systems and powerful graphic workstations. Such drives are usually equipped with batteries to save data in the event of power loss, and more expensive models are equipped with backup and / or online backup systems. An example of such drivers is I-RAM. Users with enough RAM can organize a virtual machine and put it on the HDD RAM and evaluate the performance.

articleTitle: Designing Microgrid Energy Markets Using Smart Information System and Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Energy generated through centralized power plants is eventually being replaced by Renewable energy. Due to its highly volatile nature, it aids to the fluctuations in the generation of power. These fluctuations cause major inconvenience to the consumers. Due to these disadvantages, the integration of RE into the grid poses serious challenges. The conventional grid system is also not secure from hacking. We must ensure a reliable balance between generation, consumption, and the players in the grid. We also need to make sure the grid and the communication in the grid network is secure. To tackle these challenges, we introduce a trade between the prosumers and consumers in a Peer-to-Peer fashion. All this can be achieved with the help of a blockchain network and smart contracts. Blockchain is a safe, secure and reliable platform and is tamper-proof. This paper presents the use of Blockchain and smart contracts to design a framework for energy trading in the developing countries.

articleTitle: User Detection in Smartphones Using Voting and Stacking Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: The objective is to facilitate restricted content delivery to users of age 3–12 years thereby ensuring irrelevant content is filtered out. Living in an era driven by technology where Smartphones take a lion's share of time, the probability of being served with harmful, sensitive, or obscene content is on the higher side. To bring this down, this research have come up with a model that can help assure relevant content is served upon request, when used by children. This study have leveraged Stacking and Voting algorithms to segregate the users based on tap, swipe, etc., Hyperparameter tuning has also been leveraged on these algorithms to achieve better results. It has been noticed that the ANN algorithm provides better accuracy of 97.43 % by considering all the features and stacking produces 96% accuracy using Euclidean distance on the features such as tap and swipe on the dataset. Stacking produces 94.4% accuracy by combining all the features from the task such as tap, swipe, slide, rotation, and zoom in and out on the dataset.

articleTitle: The Performance Optimization for Save and Restore Applications of Switching to New Firmware Using a Clean Install Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: When switching to new firmware using a clean install approach, I find it easier to set up programs afresh. And the appearance of errors in this case is not reduced at all, especially when switching to the next major version of the firmware. But many users find it more convenient to save application settings and restore them with new firmware. In this paper, The performance optimization for save and restore applications of switching to new firmware using a clean install approach. This is especially true for third-party programs that are not available in the market. Let's focus on two popular apps with millions of downloads. The point is that such programs provide an easy and reliable way to restore the computer in the event of any software and hardware failure, and provide an excellent way to copy the content to another hard drive. Sometimes the installation of new devices or some tests not approved by Microsoft lead to the destruction of the computer, and the working environment looks completely bad after the virus attack.

articleTitle: Covid the Board System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: The dark cloud of the vigorously spreading pandemic is still seen hovering over our heads. Though the situation presently seems under control, a continuation of the same is not guaranteed. The massive disturbance to the environmental assets leading to the melting of polar ice caps, ozone depletion, global warming, etc., poses a towering threat to every surviving species. The most recently faced devastation by the people is the “Corona” virus; a ginormous pandemic, which has affected people living in almost every nook and corner of the world. For which the primary steps were to wear a mask, maintain social distancing and sanitize almost every single thing that comes in physical contact with more than one human. This brings in a crucial technical catastrophe, the physical barrier to be maintained, and the face masks covering the face, making fingerprint and face recognition systems totally impractical. This demands a grave need for a situation-friendly technical solution.

articleTitle: DOCBOT: A CLINICAL CHATBOT THAT PROVIDES END-TO-END SOLUTIONS FOR THE USER
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: With India's growing population, birth rates are rising, and death rates are declining due to advances in the medical field. It is found that the number of doctors is the main factor that makes young people help increase population growth. This situation is better understood when we go to urban public hospitals where the low availability of doctors is a significant cause of patient neglect and in some cases leads to death. Sometimes even doctors can make mistakes in providing appropriate treatment that leads to the death of the patient. To solve those problems there is a smart and intelligent chatbot that offers medical advice and specific safety precautions that patients should take

articleTitle: More Efficient Data Security by DEVELOINV AES Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: The development of cloud apps enables people to exchange resources, goods, and expertise online with other clients. The material is more vulnerable to numerous security dangers from outsiders due to the fact that millions of users exchange data through the same system. How to maintain the security of this data is now the main concern. The current data protection system functions best when it places a greater priority on safeguarding data maintained in online storage than it does on cybersecurity during transportation. The data becomes open to intrusion attacks while being transferred. Additionally, the present craze states that an outside auditor may view data as it is being transmitted. Additionally, by allowing the hacker to assume a third-person identity while obtaining the information, this makes the data more susceptible to exploitation. The proposed system focuses on using encryption to safeguard information flow since cybersecurity is seen as a major issue. The approach also takes into account the fourth auditing issue, which is that under the recommended manner, the inspector is not allowed to see the user information. Tests have shown that the recommended technique improves security overall by making it harder for hackers to decode the supplied data.

articleTitle: Analysis of Echo from Human Heart due to UWB Pulse using EM Solver
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: This paper analyses the echoes from human heart based on the frequency response which is studied from the simulation of a layered model of UWB pulse propagation through a human thorax. Implementation of the dispersive dielectric behavior for human body tissues is done according to the Cole-Cole model. The power transmission coefficients are calculated in the ultra-wideband (UWB) frequency span of 1–10 GHz by employing EM simulation tool, CST Microwave Studio (MWS). The results show that the absolute magnitudes of these coefficients have a correspondence with the physical sizes of the periodically oscillating human heart. This unique feature resulting as the outcome of this work can be used as an indicator of the cardiac performance of a person.

articleTitle: Web Application Based Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Authentication is one of the primary problems with system security. The key component of the access control process to prevent unauthorised users from accessing data and resources is authentication, which may be described as the act of verifying a user's identity. The validity of the user cannot be guaranteed by a static technique of authentication. This led to the development of more cutting-edge authentication techniques. To increase the system's security, two factor authentication was initially deployed, followed by multi factor authentication. Later, adaptive authentication was added and it also had some problems. When authenticating a user in this study, an unique collection of user features was taken into account. A performance optimization technique was included since this research takes many user factors into account, and it improved performance by 25%.

articleTitle: Authentication tokens based smart backup and recovery system for modern android systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: After rooting a Smartphone, the average user starts experimenting with the device and installing various interface tweaks, themes, fonts, new kernels, firmware, radio and root apps. Permanent, long-standing and active user forums and XDA developers, such tests often end up with questions. Basic backup functions that satisfy most casual users, Google recommend. There is a tab called “Accounts” in the phone settings where you can check the required checkboxes. After flashing or resetting the device to factory settings or activating a new Android phone, it restores contacts, history and tabs in the Chrome browser, notes Google Keep, photos, application data, calendar events and more. In this paper, Authentication tokens based smart backup and recovery system for modern android systems. In recent Android versions, you can restore the desktop with all shortcuts and automatically install all previously installed applications. However, Google cannot back up everything. System and application settings will be reset, saved passwords will disappear, and applications from third-party markets will not be reinstalled. So, we need tools that can save everything in general.

articleTitle: Self-Driving Car Using Neural Networks and Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: In recent years, lidar has been one of the most important sensors in autonomous vehicles; nevertheless, its high price makes scale production impractical. As a result, we will describe the operation of a self-driving automobile prototype that makes use of a more cost-effective cameras and computer vision, the major purpose of our prototype is to provide a means to travel across our virtual environment in a manner that is not only secure but also expedient, effective, and comfortable. We have been able to recognize lanes, traffic signals, obstructions, and also have utilised the notion of stereo vision in order to calculate depth. Additionally, trajectory planning and steering control have been incorporated into the system. The proposed work indicate that camera-based autonomous vehicles are feasible, and as a result, our research has the potential to serve as a foundation for all future real-world implementations. The proposed Self Driving Car using Neural Networks and Computer Vision detects lane lines on streets and highways, traffic light detection and front collision avoidance in various climate conditions. Lane detection technique, to a noteworthy degree, improves the security in the independent vehicles. A self-propelled or a self-sufficient vehicle is an independent machine that detects the natural conditions and settles on an appropriate human-like decision. The purpose of this project is to find a feasible solution to detect lanes, traffic light detection and front collision avoidance on a low voltage computer that can be easily powered in a regular auto vehicle.

articleTitle: The smart network protection for Uninterruptible power supply based switching model in telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: Uninterruptible power supply is used in most cases to protect network and other telecommunications equipment and groups of computers. The main feature of these sources is the ability to adjust the output voltage regardless of the input voltage (high or low) without connecting to batteries. Advantages of this type of UPS are small size, low cost, automatic voltage regulation, cost effective. articleTitle: An Investigation into the creation of a Monitoring System that Works in Real Time within a Smart Grid Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Interdisciplinary Humanitarian Conference for Sustainability (IIHC)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety and reliability of the electricity grid, real-time monitoring is required. In this research, we describe a low-cost, low-power-consuming system for real-time, precise monitoring of power system parameters in a smart grid setting. The ultra low power micro controller used in the system ensures constant monitoring of key power system characteristics such as voltage, current, phasor difference, power factor, and power consumption. PIC16F877A micro controller is used to measure and track power system characteristics for both resistive and inductive loads. The phase difference between voltage and current can be determined with the help of zero crossing detectors and the sampling theorem. The NI Multisim programme was used to do simulations of the voltage, current, and phasor difference.
